reviews.t: King of Glory is a great church with a heart to pursue the Kingdom of God. They have a family atmosphere and it is truly a place that feels like home.
What a wonderful church that truly embraces family and community! Everyone makes you feel so loved! King Of Glory is awesome!
Awesome people. The presence of God is here. Worship rocks!
Genuine people and very much a family church. Love it!
My current home... Of course it's awesome...
